item.title: Man dies after being found shot in driver's seat of vehicle in Philadelphia: police
item.description: The Philadelphia Police Department is looking for answers after a 40-year-old man was found shot and unconscious in his Nissan Ultima on the 6700 block of Upland Street late Thursday night. Officers from the Philadelphia Police Department were called to the 6700 block of Upland Street around midnight for reports of a shooting.Police found the 40-year-old man in the front seat of his vehicle suffering from a single gunshot wound in the abdomen. item.description: U.S. Customs and Border Protection officers in Philadelphia recently seized dozens of ancient swords and arrowheads, believed to be nearly 4,000 years old, after they arrived in a shipment from the United Arab Emirates.Officers seized 36 copper-alloy short swords and 50 copper-alloy arrowheads on Feb. 18 after the items arrived on an express delivery flight from the United Arab Emirates.
